name: Yongjian Wang

intro.zh: 探索生物启发的智能，也让智能走向真实应用。
intro.en: Exploring brain-inspired intelligence. Building for the real world.

about.zh: 我的研究围绕脉冲神经网络、强化学习与科学智能展开，关注网络结构、学习机制与可验证推理之间的联系。我也将这些方法应用于计算病理、生理时序建模和低功耗神经形态计算。
about.en: My research spans spiking neural networks, reinforcement learning, and AI for science, with an interest in how network structure, learning mechanisms, and verifiable reasoning fit together. I also work on computational pathology, physiological time-series modeling, and low-power neuromorphic computing.

title.zh: 让脑拓扑参与连续控制

text.zh: 将生物脑拓扑嵌入脉冲神经网络，以 ARS 进化策略优化连接权重，在 MuJoCo 连续控制任务中探索结构与学习的协同。
text.en: Embedding biological brain topology into spiking networks and optimizing synaptic weights with adaptive random search for continuous-control tasks in MuJoCo.

title.zh: 从整张切片到病灶定位
title.en: From whole slides to lesion localization

text.zh: 围绕软组织肿瘤分级与皮肤病理图像，研究基于 Virchow2 的多实例学习、条件分割，以及基于 DINOv2 的病灶识别与弱监督分割。
text.en: Working on soft-tissue tumor grading and skin pathology through Virchow2-based multiple-instance learning, conditional segmentation, and DINOv2-based lesion recognition and weak supervision.

title.zh: 连续时间的生理信号建模

text.zh: 结合多模态生理信号、时频分析与 Neural ODE，建模术中生理变化并研究低血压等高危事件的提前预测。
text.en: Combining multimodal physiological signals, time-frequency analysis, and neural ODEs to model intraoperative dynamics and investigate early prediction of events such as hypotension.

title.zh: 连接类脑算法与低功耗硬件

text.zh: 搭建包含 LIF / Izhikevich 神经元和 STDP 在线学习的仿真验证平台，参与神经形态芯片的算法设计、硬件映射与协同迭代。
text.en: Building simulation workflows with LIF / Izhikevich neurons and STDP online learning, with work spanning algorithm design, hardware mapping, and neuromorphic system iteration.

text.zh: 可审计的实验智能体原型：执行、恢复输出绑定、独立验证与过程回放。
text.en: An inspectable experiment-agent prototype for execution, output-binding recovery, independent verification, and replay.

text.zh: 离线检查训练、验证与测试集之间的样本、分组和内容重叠。
text.en: Offline checks for sample, group, and content overlap across declared dataset splits.

text.zh: 严格对齐实验单元的配对比较，输出效应量、Bootstrap 区间与符号翻转检验。
text.en: Strictly aligned paired comparisons with effect estimates, bootstrap intervals, and sign-flip tests.
